frame: model space = elevator transport-local frame (world = origin + R(pi) * local); floor heights are local z, world z = origin z + local z (raised origin 7.03378, lowered -6.86794)
method: For each heading (degrees from local +x) and radius, the highest triangle surface at or below local z 4.0 under that (x, y), by a vertical ray through all 992 triangles (tests/test_nefarian_platform_profile.py re-derives it when the .vmo is present). Inside a pillar block the ray passes the block top (9.925) and reports the block's underside (-8.666).

fit.note: least squares over every sample with 22 <= r <= 32; the flat centre carries two decorative ridges (+0.2 to +0.23 near r 9.5-10.5 and r 19-21)
fit.max_model_error_note: largest |sample - fit| over samples at least 7.5 yd from every pillar centre; the pillar skirts (up to local z 2.2 within 6 yd of a centre) are excluded and covered by pillar_footprints

pillar_footprints.method: For each pillar centre and heading (degrees from local +x), the first distance after the last sample, every 0.05 yd out to 9 yd, whose vertical ray (at or below local z 4.0) finds no surface or a surface more than 0.3 from the ring height 1.439: the block, its skirt and any gap. Every pillar stands wholly on the ring (its footprint ends beyond r 34.5). At 1-degree resolution no footprint exceeds the larger of its two neighbouring 5-degree samples by more than interpolation_margin.
